description: Compute the seam between this design and another by COMPLEMENTARY ROLE: each boundary declares a role on `Interface.designation`, and `published`/`both` pairs with `required`/`both` when their NAMES match fuzzily AND they agree on medium, transport_security and auth. Five outcomes: paired; CONFLICTS (names match, axes refuse, every refusing axis named); unmet needs; dead surface; duplicate providers. Uncertain name matches are CANDIDATES to ask about; boundaries with no role are counted and NAMED. Pass `design` (an export document) or, on a registry server, `other_graph_id`. Feed `paired` to seam_report. Ask for this to match our required contracts against what the other system publishes.

design.description:
The other design, as a published-surface or full export document.
Pass this OR `other_graph_id`, never both.

other_graph_id.description:
The other design BY GRAPH_ID, on a server that holds many designs (a
registry behind a trusted host): it is read from the design the server
already holds, inside the set of designs the host says you may read.
Refused on a single-design server, and for a design outside that set.

name: pair_designs
title: Pair Two Designs
